No. The **67.7 ha loss was recorded in 2020**, before the 31 December 2020 EUDR cut-off.

For 2021–2025, no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected. The data did record 0.4 ha of loss in patches smaller than 0.5 ha in 2021.

This evidence does not establish that no other small changes occurred, nor does it determine EUDR compliance.
